signals.name: Grounding

signals.name: Option completeness

signals.name: Replay consistency

signals.name: Rule conformance

signals.name: Calibration

signals.name: Baseline drift

signals.name: Contradiction

signals.name: Freshness

AIG-001.name: Agent Registry
AIG-001.logic: Register purpose, owner, tier, autonomy (Advise/Act), tools, rules, data classes and breaker profile; unregistered agents cannot run

AIG-002.name: Per-Agent MTBH Circuit Breaker
AIG-002.logic: Track integrity faults; half-open when MTBH < floor (tier 1: 2,000; tier 2: 500; tier 3: 200 outputs) or probes regress; open below 500/100/50 or 3 faults in a row

AIG-003.name: Hard-Trip Signals
AIG-003.logic: Open the breaker immediately and run the fail-closed fallback; reset only by the named owner after root cause

AIG-004.name: Decision-Question Probes
AIG-004.logic: Run the 48 decision questions through the decision path; regression against baseline sets integrity signal IS-7

AIG-005.name: AI System Impact Assessment
AIG-005.logic: Assess impacts on prospects, clients, employees and the PEO; record mitigations; reviewed by governance council

AIG-006.name: Autonomy Promotion Criteria
AIG-006.logic: Requires 30 consecutive days at or above the MTBH floor, zero hard trips and owner and council approval

AIG-007.name: Tool Allow-List and Least Privilege
AIG-007.logic: Only registered tools with least-privilege scopes; tool calls outside the allow-list are blocked and counted as integrity faults

AIG-008.name: Integrity Fault Definition (MTBH)
AIG-008.logic: Count as a fault: unsupported claim, contradiction with Released knowledge, rule violation, or baseline regression; MTBH = outputs ÷ faults over a rolling 30 days

AIG-009.name: Named Owner and Kill Switch
AIG-009.logic: Each agent has a named owner with authority to open the breaker manually at any time

AIG-010.name: Bias Testing of Recommendations
AIG-010.logic: Test that recommendations and eligibility answers do not differ by prospect attributes that proxy for protected classes (e.g. ZIP, ownership)

AIG-011.name: Model and Agent Cards
AIG-011.logic: Publish a card: purpose, data, evaluation results, limits, breaker profile and owner

BEN-001.name: Applicable Large Employer (ALE) Determination
BEN-001.logic: Determine ALE status from full-time + FTE headcount across the controlled group

BEN-004.name: Annual IRS Form 1094-C/1095-C Generation
BEN-004.logic: Generate and file 1094-C/1095-C forms by IRS deadline for all ALE clients

BEN-019.name: Carrier EDI 834 Enrollment Feed Integration
BEN-019.logic: Transmit standardized 834 EDI enrollment transaction to carrier

CALC-001.name: Time to useful answer
CALC-001.logic: median(t_first_useful_answer − t_question) per session; useful = persona marks “answered” or BPA accepts the brief

CALC-002.name: Steps to confirm eligibility
CALC-002.logic: median(count of advisor turns from first Qualify question to eligibility verdict)

CALC-003.name: Sales cycle time to binding quote

CALC-004.name: Census first-pass validation rate
CALC-004.logic: uploads passing census validation on first attempt ÷ uploads

CALC-005.name: Re-quote rate after signature
CALC-005.logic: deals re-quoted within 90 days of signature ÷ signed deals

CALC-006.name: Follow-up-free proposal sessions
CALC-006.logic: Propose sessions with no clarification question within 7 days ÷ Propose sessions

CALC-007.name: First-draft owner approval rate
CALC-007.logic: decision packages approved without change ÷ packages shared with owners

CALC-008.name: Cut-over errors per 100 employees
CALC-008.logic: payroll corrections in the first PEO payroll ÷ employees paid × 100

CALC-009.name: Hiring states assessed
CALC-009.logic: jurisdictions with a completed assessment ÷ jurisdictions resolved for the prospect (GOV-007)

CALC-010.name: Time to compare plans
CALC-010.logic: median(active time on plan comparison briefs per session)

CALC-011.name: Handbook policies unmapped
CALC-011.logic: policies without a Released mapping ÷ handbook policies

CALC-012.name: Decisions with a risk brief
CALC-012.logic: Decide-stage decisions linked to a risk brief ÷ Decide-stage decisions

CALC-013.name: Coverage gap per 1,000
CALC-013.logic: employees with ≥ 1 day without coverage after go-live ÷ enrolled employees × 1,000

CALC-014.name: Outcome gap ratio
CALC-014.logic: minimize: max(0, (delivered − target) ÷ target); maximize: max(0, (target − delivered) ÷ target); target 0 ⇒ 1 if delivered > 0; capped at 1

CALC-015.name: Outcome gap status
CALC-015.logic: met if gap = 0; gap if gap > 0 and n ≥ 30; otherwise insufficient data

CALC-016.name: Opportunity score
CALC-016.logic: importance + max(importance − satisfaction, 0), with importance and satisfaction on 0–10 (survey % rating 4–5 × 10)

CALC-017.name: Value at stake per job step
CALC-017.logic: driver weight × outcomes (3) × (1 + gap ratio) × (1 + tier-H questions ÷ 4)

CALC-018.name: Component impact score
CALC-018.logic: max(1, 5 × Σ(dependency strength × value at stake) ÷ Σ(3 × value at stake))

CALC-019.name: Component likelihood score
CALC-019.logic: mean(novelty, complexity, readiness gap, dependency depth, schedule pressure)

CALC-021.name: Decision outcome attainment
CALC-021.logic: decisions whose bound outcome met target at checkpoint ÷ decisions past checkpoint

CALC-022.name: Causal effect estimate
CALC-022.logic: effect of a change or decision on an outcome, by the method declared in the finding (e.g. difference-in-differences) with a 90% interval and stated DAG

CALC-023.name: Brief grounding score
CALC-023.logic: statements with ≥ 1 valid supporting claim span ÷ statements in the brief

CALC-024.name: Citation precision
CALC-024.logic: citations whose span supports the statement ÷ citations checked (sample of 5% of briefs, all tier-H)

CALC-025.name: Answer equivalence rate
CALC-025.logic: probe runs with all golden claims present and no contradiction ÷ probe runs

CALC-026.name: Option integrity
CALC-026.logic: |options shown ∩ permitted| ÷ |permitted|; ranking stability = Kendall τ between replay rankings

CALC-027.name: MTBH (mean time between hallucinations)
CALC-027.logic: outputs ÷ integrity faults over a rolling 30 days; ∞ when no faults

CALC-028.name: Breaker state
CALC-028.logic: OPEN if hard trip or MTBH < open threshold or 3 consecutive faults; HALF-OPEN if MTBH < floor or probe regression; else CLOSED

CALC-029.name: Breaker trip rate
CALC-029.logic: briefs held or blocked by a breaker ÷ briefs produced

CALC-030.name: Change risk score
CALC-030.logic: question tier weight (H 3, M 2, L 1) × change severity (benign 1, material 2, breaking 3)

CALC-031.name: Brief withdrawal latency
CALC-031.logic: p95(t_brief_withdrawn − t_change_event) for briefs in an impact set

CALC-033.name: Classification precision
CALC-033.logic: correct labels ÷ labels assigned on a steward-labelled sample of ≥ 400 items

CALC-035.name: Content freshness
CALC-035.logic: age = now − source lastModified; share of served objects past validUntil (must be 0)

CALC-036.name: Required-field completeness
CALC-036.logic: required fields present ÷ required fields, per source

CALC-037.name: Regulatory claim binding rate
CALC-037.logic: regulatory claims bound to a Released rule ÷ regulatory claims

CALC-038.name: PII leak count
CALC-038.logic: assembled parts with PII and no consent record (target 0)

CALC-039.name: Control pass rate
CALC-039.logic: control tests passed ÷ control tests run

CALC-040.name: Finding age and overdue count
CALC-040.logic: days open per finding; findings past due date

CALC-041.name: Rule currency
CALC-041.logic: Released rules reviewed within 12 months or since last source change ÷ Released rules

CALC-042.name: Policy decision latency
CALC-042.logic: p95 policy decision latency; timeouts that failed closed

CALC-043.name: Waiver exposure
CALC-043.logic: active waivers × days remaining; expired waivers still referenced (target 0)

CALC-044.name: Event dead-letter rate
CALC-044.logic: dead-lettered events ÷ events; oldest dead letter age

CALC-045.name: Deadline lead-time compliance
CALC-045.logic: deadline events emitted at ≥ lead time ÷ deadline events

CALC-046.name: Buffer consumption
CALC-046.logic: max(0, actual predecessor finish − planned predecessor finish) ÷ buffer length

CALC-047.name: Lifecycle phase score
CALC-047.logic: Σ assessed maturity ÷ Σ target maturity for the phase (0–3 scale)

CALC-048.name: Client retention
CALC-048.logic: 1 − Σ lost clients ÷ Σ clients at period start (ratio of sums); loss dated at last payroll processed

CALC-049.name: Worksite employee growth
CALC-049.logic: (average monthly paid WSE this period − prior period) ÷ prior period

CALC-050.name: Service satisfaction
CALC-050.logic: top-two-box responses (4 or 5) ÷ responses, weighted by responses on roll-up

CMP-010.name: Workers' Comp Class Codes / NCCI Mapping
CMP-010.logic: Map client job roles to NCCI class codes to set premium risk baseline

CON-001.name: Unique canonical identity
CON-001.logic: Exactly one canonical URI and one contentHash per object; the same hash from two sources resolves to one object

CON-002.name: Version lineage
CON-002.logic: A new version has prov:wasRevisionOf pointing to the prior version

CON-003.name: Claim has a source span
CON-003.logic: Exactly one hasSourceSpan and a confidence in [0, 1]

CON-005.name: Validity window
CON-005.logic: validUntil present (or a supersession policy); served only when request time ≤ validUntil

CON-006.name: Access label required
CON-006.logic: Exactly one sensitivity label from the sensitivity vocabulary

CON-007.name: No PII without consent
CON-007.logic: piiDetected = true ⇒ consentRecord present, otherwise quarantined

CON-008.name: Third-party text limit
CON-008.logic: Store facts and summaries only, with sourceURL; no verbatim passage longer than 25 words reaches a persona

CON-009.name: Crawl allow-list and robots
CON-009.logic: URL in allow-list AND robots/licence permits AND supplier assessed

CON-010.name: Mapping strength for assembly
CON-010.logic: Relation ∈ {exactMatch, closeMatch} AND score ≥ 0.85; broader matches only for search

CON-012.name: Regulatory claims are bound
CON-012.logic: boundToRule → an SSOT rule with status Released
CON-012.onv: Hold as Candidate; route to rule owner

CON-013.name: KGCL stamp on every write
CON-013.logic: WHO, WHAT, WHEN, WHERE and WHY present on each change record

CON-014.name: Ontology import closure
CON-014.logic: Imports isp-core via owl:imports; no orphan classes; no unresolved terms

CON-015.name: Dual representation of Released rules
CON-015.logic: Released ⇒ LKIF norm AND SHACL shape AND compiled-target hash present

CON-016.name: Rule lifecycle transitions
CON-016.logic: Draft → Candidate → Released → Retired only; author ≠ approver ≠ deployer

CON-017.name: No overlapping effective dates
CON-017.logic: validFrom ≤ validTo; no two Released versions of a rule overlap for the same jurisdiction

CON-018.name: Tenant isolation
CON-018.logic: request.tenant present AND every result and event ∈ request.tenant

CON-019.name: Persona entitlement
CON-019.logic: part.label ∈ entitlements(persona, tenant); internal pricing, margin and win-loss never for prospect personas

CON-020.name: Census field allow-list
CON-020.logic: Fields ⊆ {age or DOB, ZIP, wage, class code, coverage tier, hours}; no SSN or health detail before signature

CON-021.name: No personal data in events
CON-021.logic: Schema contains only URIs and claim-check tokens for PII or PHI classes

CON-022.name: Small-cut suppression
CON-022.logic: n ≥ 5 per published cell, else suppressed

CON-023.name: Prospect data retention
CON-023.logic: age since last activity ≤ 24 months, unless legal hold

CON-024.name: No census data in logs
CON-024.logic: No direct identifiers or census fields in any log line

CON-025.name: Complete decision record
CON-025.logic: context bundle, ≥ 1 option shown, chosen option, actor, rule versions, brief hash and ≥ 1 bound outcome on a Released metric card

CON-027.name: Option evidence
CON-027.logic: effect, downstream events, risk and bound outcome present, each cited

CON-028.name: Human confirmation for binding actions
CON-028.logic: approvedBy is a human with decision rights AND Simplex check passed

CON-030.name: Grounding floor
CON-030.logic: grounding ≥ 0.80; ≥ 0.90 when it answers a tier-H decision question

CON-031.name: Brief composition
CON-031.logic: ≤ 6 statements; ≥ 1 governed internal source; Candidate items labelled “pending review”

CON-032.name: Eligibility inputs
CON-032.logic: features ⊆ approved rule inputs; no protected attributes or close proxies

CON-034.name: Savings claims substantiated
CON-034.logic: quoteRef AND assumptions present; stated as a range

CON-035.name: Competitor claims sourced and current
CON-035.logic: sourceURL present AND retrieved ≤ 30 days ago

CON-036.name: Licensed producer for benefits quotes
CON-036.logic: licensedProducer present for the prospect’s state

CON-038.name: CloudEvents envelope
CON-038.logic: id, source, type, subject, time, tenant, correlationId and traceparent present

CON-039.name: Registered event type
CON-039.logic: type and schema version exist in the event type registry

CON-040.name: Event authorization
CON-040.logic: producer and consumer authorized for type and tenant

CON-041.name: Idempotency
CON-041.logic: (consumer, event id) processed at most once

CON-042.name: Deadline lead time
CON-042.logic: emitted at ≥ the lead time before the statutory or carrier deadline

CON-044.name: Registered agents only
CON-044.logic: agent ∈ registry with owner, tier and breaker profile

CON-045.name: Tool allow-list
CON-045.logic: tool ∈ agent.allowedTools with scope ⊆ granted scope

CON-046.name: Breaker state gate
CON-046.logic: CLOSED ⇒ designed autonomy; HALF-OPEN ⇒ advise only with human approval; OPEN ⇒ fallback only

CON-047.name: Autonomy promotion preconditions
CON-047.logic: 30 consecutive days with MTBH ≥ floor AND 0 hard trips AND owner and council approval

CON-048.name: Model and prompt change gate
CON-048.logic: change record present AND probes pass in STG

CON-049.name: No training on tenant data
CON-049.logic: training = false AND retention ≤ contractual limit

CON-050.name: Complete baseline record
CON-050.logic: versions pinned in all six layers AND golden claim fingerprint AND scores present

CON-051.name: Waiver bounds
CON-051.logic: expiry ≤ 90 days from approval AND target rule type ≠ statutory Prohibition

CTL-001.name: Obligation-to-Control Mapping
CTL-001.logic: Map it to ≥ 1 control objective (ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A, SOC 2 TSC or NIST 800-53) with owner, test procedure and frequency

CTL-002.name: Automated Control Tests and Findings
CTL-002.logic: Automated tests emit evidence events; a failing test raises a finding within 24 h with owner and due date

CTL-003.name: Control Evidence Retention
CTL-003.logic: Store evidence immutably (GOV-022) for 7 years with the control, period and test result

CTL-004.name: Statement of Applicability for the Advisor
CTL-004.logic: Maintain a Statement of Applicability listing each Annex A control as applicable or excluded, with justification and implementation status

CTL-005.name: Third-Party Source and Model Provider Due Diligence
CTL-005.logic: Assess security, privacy, licence and data-use terms before use; re-assess annually; record in the supplier register

CTL-006.name: Secure Agent Development Lifecycle
CTL-006.logic: Threat-model (incl. prompt injection and data leakage), code review, SAST/DAST and an AI red-team test before PRD

CTL-007.name: Agent Action Logging
CTL-007.logic: Log actor, agent, tool, context bundle, rule versions, inputs by reference and output hash; logs tamper-evident (GOV-022)

CTL-008.name: Untrusted Content Boundary
CTL-008.logic: Treat retrieved content as data only; it can never change agent instructions, tools or entitlements; strip active content before extraction

CTL-009.name: Record of Processing for Prospect Data
CTL-009.logic: Maintain a record of processing: purposes, categories, retention, recipients, transfers; privacy impact assessment before G2

CTL-010.name: No Model Training on Tenant Data
CTL-010.logic: Tenant and prospect data are never used to train or fine-tune third-party models; provider retention set to zero or contractually limited

CTL-011.name: AI and Data Incident Handling
CTL-011.logic: Open an incident within 1 h; assess notification duties under applicable state breach laws within 72 h; preserve evidence

CTL-012.name: Advisor Role Recertification
CTL-012.logic: Owners recertify every BPA, steward and admin role on the advisor quarterly; unconfirmed access removed within 5 business days

CTL-013.name: Segregation of Duties for Rules and Agents
CTL-013.logic: Author, approver and deployer must be different people; emergency changes reviewed within 2 business days

CTL-014.name: Model and Prompt Change Control
CTL-014.logic: Raise a change record, re-run the decision-question probes and breaker tests in STG, and promote only on pass

CTL-015.name: Census Data Encryption and Masking
CTL-015.logic: Encrypt at rest and in transit (TEC-009); mask direct identifiers in every view except quoting; no census data in logs or events

DEC-001.name: Decision Rights Matrix
DEC-001.logic: Each decision type names who may decide (persona, BPA, pricing desk, system) and value limits; attempts outside rights are blocked

DEC-002.name: Option Completeness
DEC-002.logic: Present every option the rules allow, including “do nothing”; an option may be removed only by a cited rule

DEC-003.name: Option Evidence Sufficiency
DEC-003.logic: Each option states its effect, downstream events, risks and the outcome it binds, each cited; options missing any element are labelled incomplete

DEC-004.name: No Automated Binding Commitments
DEC-004.logic: The advisor may recommend only; a human with decision rights confirms through the Simplex gate

DEC-005.name: Recommendation Neutrality and Disclosure
DEC-005.logic: Ranking criteria are disclosed; internal margin and commission may not influence ranking (EXT-006); any conflict of interest disclosed

DEC-006.name: Immutable Decision Record
DEC-006.logic: Store context bundle, options shown, option chosen, actor, rule versions, brief hash, bound outcome and time as an immutable isp-dec record

DEC-007.name: Reversibility Classification
DEC-007.logic: Classify as reversible, costly to reverse, or irreversible; costly and irreversible decisions require human confirmation and a UCA check

DEC-008.name: Override With Reason
DEC-008.logic: Override allowed with a reason code; overrides feed value-gap analysis and the agent’s breaker statistics

DEC-009.name: Tier-H Decision Confirmation
DEC-009.logic: Grounding ≥ 0.90 and no open breaker on the decision path; otherwise the brief is held for BPA confirmation

DEC-010.name: AI Disclosure to Personas
DEC-010.logic: Label briefs as AI-assembled, show sources, and offer a human (BPA) at every decision

DEC-011.name: Adverse Outcome Explanation
DEC-011.logic: Give the reason, the rule cited and what would change the outcome

DEC-012.name: Eligibility Decided by Rules Only
DEC-012.logic: Use SSOT eligibility and underwriting rules only; no model inference from employee characteristics; protected characteristics never used except as a statute requires

EVT-001.name: CloudEvents Envelope
EVT-001.logic: Use CloudEvents 1.0 (id, source, type, subject, time) plus extensions: tenant, persona, decisionId, ruleVersion, correlationId, traceparent

EVT-002.name: Event Type Registry
EVT-002.logic: Register type, JSON Schema, owner, producers, consumers and data classification in the SSOT; unregistered types are rejected by the broker

EVT-003.name: Idempotent Consumers
EVT-003.logic: Deduplicate by event id; side effects are idempotent so redelivery never repeats an action

EVT-004.name: Ordering and Causation
EVT-004.logic: Preserve order per subject; every event carries causationId and correlationId so a decision’s full chain can be traced

EVT-005.name: Transactional Outbox
EVT-005.logic: Write the state change and the event in one transaction (outbox); publish from the outbox

EVT-006.name: Saga With Compensation
EVT-006.logic: Each step declares its compensating action and timeout; a failed step triggers compensation of completed steps

EVT-007.name: Retry and Dead-Letter
EVT-007.logic: Retry with exponential backoff up to 5 times, then dead-letter; dead letters triaged within 1 business day

EVT-008.name: Deadline Events From SSOT Rules
EVT-008.logic: Emit scheduled events with lead time (e.g. carrier 834 cut-off minus 10 business days) so decisions and tasks are raised before the deadline

EVT-009.name: Event Authorization
EVT-009.logic: Authorize per event type and tenant (ABAC); cross-tenant subscriptions are prohibited

EVT-010.name: References, Not Payloads
EVT-010.logic: Events carry URIs and claim-check tokens, never PII or PHI payloads

EVT-011.name: Event Retention and Replay
EVT-011.logic: Retain 13 months for replay; replayed events are tagged and never re-trigger external side effects

EVT-012.name: Knowledge-Layer Change Events
EVT-012.logic: Emit a typed change event naming the changed resource and version; Impact Analyzer subscribes (EXT-016)

EVT-013.name: SLA Timers and Escalation
EVT-013.logic: Start a timer; on breach emit an escalation event to the next owner

EVT-014.name: Rule Triggers as Event Patterns
EVT-014.logic: Express the trigger as a registered event pattern so the rule is evaluated when the event occurs, not by polling

EXT-001.name: Canonical Content Identity
EXT-001.logic: URI = source system + native item ID + content hash; a new version links with prov:wasRevisionOf; duplicates across sources collapse to one isp-cnt:ContentObject

EXT-002.name: Classification Confidence Floor
EXT-002.logic: Accept at confidence ≥ 0.80; 0.60–0.79 held as Candidate for steward review; below 0.60 left unclassified

EXT-003.name: PII and Consent Gate
EXT-003.logic: Do not publish or assemble content containing PII unless a consent record is attached; quarantine the item and notify its owner

EXT-004.name: Third-Party Content Use
EXT-004.logic: Store facts and short summaries with a source link; never reproduce third-party text verbatim to a persona; honor robots.txt and license terms

EXT-005.name: Freshness and Expiry by Content Type
EXT-005.logic: validUntil from the source, else by type: competitor offers 30 days, rate sheets plan year, regulatory items until superseded; expired content leaves assemblies

EXT-006.name: Persona Entitlements
EXT-006.logic: Allow only parts labelled for that persona and tenant; internal pricing, margin and win-loss content is never assembled for prospect personas

EXT-007.name: Claim Span Traceability
EXT-007.logic: Every claim records its source span (slide, page, cell or block) and confidence; claims without a span are discarded

EXT-008.name: Regulatory Claims Bind to SSOT Rules
EXT-008.logic: Bind the claim to an SSOT rule URI before assembly; unbound regulatory claims are held as Candidate and routed to the rule owner

EXT-009.name: Mapping Correspondence Minimum
EXT-009.logic: exactMatch, or closeMatch ≥ 0.85, for assembly; broader matches may guide search only

EXT-010.name: RDF Shape Conformance
EXT-010.logic: Validate against isp-cnt SHACL shapes; violations block publish; every write stamped with KGCL WHO/WHAT/WHEN/WHERE/WHY

EXT-011.name: Federated Query Scope
EXT-011.logic: Scope every query by the context bundle (persona, tenant, jurisdiction, stage); queries run in place through the virtual graph

EXT-012.name: Grounding Threshold for Briefs
EXT-012.logic: Every statement cites a claim; grounding ≥ 0.80 (≥ 0.90 for tier-H decision questions) or the breaker trips and the question routes to a BPA

EXT-013.name: Brief Composition
EXT-013.logic: Use the persona template; at most 6 statements; at least one governed internal source; Candidate items labelled “pending review”

EXT-014.name: Decisions Bind Desired Outcomes
EXT-014.logic: Bind at least one desired outcome to a Released metric card with target and checkpoint; irreversible actions pass the Simplex gate

EXT-015.name: Value-Gap and Causal Method
EXT-015.logic: Compare desired vs delivered per job step over a 90-day window; causal estimates state the DAG, assumptions and interval; findings advisory until a human accepts them

EXT-016.name: Incremental Refresh Scope
EXT-016.logic: Refresh only nodes in the impact set; withdraw affected briefs within 1 hour; full rebuild only on a MAJOR ontology version

GOD-001.name: Policy Decision Request Contract
GOD-001.logic: A Policy Decision Point returns permit/deny, obligations, rule IDs and versions, and an explanation; Policy Enforcement Points (GOV-012) act only on that answer

GOD-002.name: Rule Version Pinning
GOD-002.logic: Evaluate only against Released rule versions; record rule IDs and versions in the decision response and in any decision record

GOD-003.name: Bitemporal Effective Dating
GOD-003.logic: Use the rule version effective on the event date (valid time), recorded against the version known at decision time (transaction time)

GOD-004.name: Explanation Obligation
GOD-004.logic: Return a plain-language reason and the citation (rule ID, statute or standard) for every permit, deny or obligation

GOD-005.name: Time-Boxed Policy Waivers
GOD-005.logic: A waiver names scope, reason, approver, compensating control and expiry ≤ 90 days; it expires automatically and every use is logged

GOD-006.name: Compiled Policy Test Gate
GOD-006.logic: Promotion to PRD requires 100% scenario tests passing, including the decision-question probes affected by the rule

GOD-007.name: Rule Ownership and Review Cadence
GOD-007.logic: Every rule has a named owner; reviewed within 12 months or within 10 business days of a change to its source

GOD-008.name: Pre-Release Impact Check
GOD-008.logic: Impact Analyzer lists affected decision questions, briefs and decisions before approval; tier-H impacts need SME sign-off

GOD-009.name: Policy Decision Latency and Fail-Closed
GOD-009.logic: p95 latency ≤ 50 ms; on timeout or error, Prohibitions and access rules fail closed (deny) and the event is logged

GOD-010.name: Jurisdiction Resolution for Requests
GOD-010.logic: Resolve jurisdictions through GOV-007; if a work location is ambiguous (e.g. remote), apply the most-stringent candidate jurisdiction and flag for confirmation

GOV-001.name: Definition-Time vs Run-Time Separation
GOV-001.logic: Author canonical truth once in RDF/OWL/LKIF/SHACL (Definition-Time); compile and execute against OPA/Rego, dbt/SQL, and agentic guardrails (Run-Time)

GOV-003.name: DEV/STG/PRD Ontology Lifecycle Gate
GOV-003.logic: Require promotion gate approval at each of DEV, STG, and PRD stages before production activation

GOV-006.name: Persistent Mapping Graph - Correspondence & Anti-Drift Lineage
GOV-006.logic: Maintain 6 correspondence types between canonical concepts and physical implementations, monitored by anti-drift lineage agents

GOV-007.name: Identity & URI Resolution Registry
GOV-007.logic: Resolve cross-silo identifiers into canonical Enterprise Entity IDs enforcing the ISO 8000 Uniqueness invariant

GOV-008.name: Rule Harmonization Engine - Cross-Jurisdiction Conflict Detection
GOV-008.logic: Run SPARQL scan across rule graph: SELECT jurisdiction, MAX(threshold) AS effective threshold; flag overlaps before publication

GOV-009.name: Most-Stringent-Rule / Highest-Employee-Protection Precedence Principle
GOV-009.logic: Enforce the rule offering the greatest employee protection / highest applicable standard as the effective rule

GOV-011.name: Requirement Context Bundle (RCB) - 5D Request Decomposition
GOV-011.logic: Decompose request into WHO (persona/tenant/target), WHAT (entity/action), WHEN (period/tax year), WHERE (jurisdiction/domain), WHY (intent/mandate) before execution

GOV-012.name: Policy Enforcement Points (PEPs)
GOV-012.logic: Evaluate transaction against domain-specific PEPs (e.g., Tax & Payroll PEP, Security PEP) before allowing execution

GOV-013.name: STPA/STAMP Unsafe Control Action (UCA) Verification
GOV-013.logic: Verify no Unsafe Control Action occurs (e.g., negative wage deduction, duplicate disbursement) before directive compilation

GOV-014.name: Circuit Breaker & MTBH Monitoring
GOV-014.logic: Track Mean Time Between Hallucinations (MTBH); trip circuit breaker and isolate fault domain when threshold is breached

GOV-015.name: Simplex Action Gate - Irreversible/Destructive Action Interception
GOV-015.logic: Halt autonomous execution and require human-in-the-loop authorization before release

GOV-016.name: Simplex Action Gate Threshold - Batch Tax Remittance Example
GOV-016.logic: Suspend automated fund disbursement and generate alert for human-in-the-loop authorization

GOV-017.name: LKIF Deontic Norm + SHACL Shape Dual Representation
GOV-017.logic: Represent the rule as a paired LKIF Deontic statement (permission/obligation/prohibition) plus a SHACL structural invariant shape

GOV-018.name: Provenance & Change Management - ORSD + KGCL Metadata
GOV-018.logic: Bind the change to an ORSD and stamp it with KGCL metadata capturing WHO, WHAT, WHEN, WHERE, WHY

GOV-019.name: 6-Stage SHACL-to-Policy Compilation Pipeline
GOV-019.logic: Execute: 1) Shape Parser, 2) Constraint Extractor, 3) Harmonization Check, 4) Target Mapper, 5) Policy Generator, 6) KGCL Version & Publish

GOV-020.name: Dual Runtime Target Compilation
GOV-020.logic: Route batch/data-pipeline enforcement to dbt/SQL (Engine A) and real-time API/gateway enforcement to OPA/Rego (Engine B)

GOV-021.name: AI Agent Guardrails - Compiled JSON Schema Constraints
GOV-021.logic: Inject compiled JSON Schema constraints (Step 5 Compiled AI Directive) at the gateway to prevent hallucinated answers

GOV-022.name: Complete Audit Traceability via Immutable URI
GOV-022.logic: Attach an immutable URI on every rejected/calculated record linking back to the specific statutory LKIF/SHACL definition that governed it

GOV-023.name: Single Source of Truth (SSOT) Propagation
GOV-023.logic: Update the single canonical OWL/SHACL triple once; compilation pipeline (GOV-019) automatically propagates the change to all downstream database engines and microservices

GOV-024.name: Zero Graph Latency Runtime Principle
GOV-024.logic: Execute compiled policy (OPA/Rego, dbt/SQL) directly, without invoking live graph reasoning, to achieve sub-millisecond/microsecond evaluation on client records

MET-001.name: Client Loss Dated at Last Payroll Processed
MET-001.logic: A client counts as lost on the date of its last processed payroll; notices not yet effective are reported as Pending Terminations

MET-002.name: Transfers Between Client Holons Are Not Losses
MET-002.logic: Record as a Consolidation Transfer when the successor Enterprise Entity ID is an active client; exclude from losses

MET-003.name: First-90-Day Exits Classified as Onboarding Fallout
MET-003.logic: Exclude from retention losses; report under the Onboarding Fallout metric

MET-004.name: HR360 to HRScale Migrations Are Product Moves
MET-004.logic: Keep the client active and record a product-move event instead of a loss

MET-005.name: Retention Roll-Up Uses Ratio of Sums
MET-005.logic: Sum losses and starting clients at each level, then divide; a SHACL shape rejects any aggregate that averages child percentages

MET-006.name: Paid Worksite Employee Definition
MET-006.logic: A worksite employee counts as paid in a month when at least one payroll was processed for them

MET-007.name: Period WSE Value Is the Average of Monthly Counts
MET-007.logic: Period value = mean of the monthly paid-WSE counts; never a point-in-time snapshot

MET-008.name: COBRA-Only Participants and 1099 Contractors Excluded from WSE Counts
MET-008.logic: Only co-employed worksite employees count; COBRA-only participants and workers classified as contractors are excluded

MET-009.name: Survey Response Window: 7 Days From Case Close
MET-009.logic: Count a response only if it arrives within 7 days of the case close date

MET-010.name: One Response per Case, Latest Wins
MET-010.logic: Keep only the latest valid response per case

MET-012.name: Satisfaction Roll-Up Weighted by Responses
MET-012.logic: Sum satisfied and valid responses at each level, then divide; averaging child scores is rejected

MET-013.name: Small-Cut Suppression (k >= 5)
MET-013.logic: Suppress the value, including cuts produced by filtering or differencing

MET-014.name: Decisions Must Bind Outcomes to Released Metric Cards
MET-014.logic: At least one outcome with a target and checkpoint date must reference a Released Metric Definition Card; otherwise the decision is flagged unmeasurable

PAY-012.name: SUTA Experience Rating Transfer / Allocation
PAY-012.logic: Allocate SUTA tax liability and experience rating per worksite jurisdiction

PAY-021.name: Federal Form 941 Quarterly Filing
PAY-021.logic: File Form 941 and remit federal payroll taxes within IRS deadline

PAY-026.name: State/Local Minimum Wage Baseline
PAY-026.logic: Effective minimum wage = MAX(federal, state, local) applicable to worksite

PAY-027.name: SUTA/FUTA Annual Wage Base Ceiling
PAY-027.logic: Apply versioned annual SUTA/FUTA wage base ceiling per tax year via temporal SWRL rules

PAY-028.name: Simplex Action Gate - High-Value Batch Tax Remittance
PAY-028.logic: Suspend automated fund disbursement; require human-in-the-loop authorization before release

PEO-006.name: Client Allocation Matrix - Statutory Responsibility & Liability Division
PEO-006.logic: Formalize division of statutory responsibilities and liability limits between PEO and client within the MSA

PEO-007.name: State PEO Licensing Board Registration Compliance
PEO-007.logic: Maintain active state PEO license/registration in each required state

QBD-001.name: Decision-Question Baseline Record
QBD-001.logic: Freeze a baseline record: data, content, knowledge, mapping and transformation versions; answer fingerprint; scores; breaker states

QBD-002.name: Change Severity Classification
QBD-002.logic: Benign = equivalent answer; Material = claim changed and explained by a Released upstream change; Breaking = changed without cause, missing golden claim, contradiction or grounding below floor

QBD-003.name: Risk Score and Routing
QBD-003.logic: Score = tier (H3, M2, L1) × severity (1–3); 1–2 log and re-baseline; 3–4 SME review; 6–9 withdraw brief and open or half-open lineage breakers

QBD-004.name: Critical Quality Attribute Criteria
QBD-004.logic: Data freshness, completeness, validity; content version, validity window, labels; ontology conformance and rule currency; mapping status and precision ≥ 0.95; replay hash; grounding, equivalence, option integrity and citation precision ≥ 0.95

QBD-005.name: Re-baseline Approval
QBD-005.logic: SME approves the new answer; the old baseline is retained as history (never overwritten)

SAL-001.name: Licensed Producer for Benefits Quotes
SAL-001.logic: Deliver through, or with sign-off by, an agent licensed in the prospect’s state; the advisor states it is not providing insurance advice

SAL-002.name: Savings Claim Substantiation
SAL-002.logic: Cite the quote data and assumptions; show ranges, not guarantees; no claim without substantiation on file

SAL-003.name: Comparative Claims About Competitors
SAL-003.logic: Facts only, sourced and dated; no unverifiable superiority claims; expired comparisons withdrawn (EXT-005)

SAL-004.name: Outreach Consent and Opt-Out
SAL-004.logic: Record consent; honour opt-outs across every agent within 10 business days (email) or immediately (calls and texts)

SAL-005.name: Indicative vs Binding Quote Authority
SAL-005.logic: Indicative quotes are labelled with validity date; binding quotes require pricing approval within the authority matrix (DEC-001)

SAL-006.name: PEO License Disclosure in Proposals
SAL-006.logic: Include the PEO’s registration or licence number and status for that state; block the proposal if registration has lapsed

SAL-007.name: Statutory Allocation Disclosure
SAL-007.logic: Include the statutory allocation of employer responsibilities for each of the prospect’s states; allocation brief must match contract clauses

SAL-008.name: Electronic Signature Consent
SAL-008.logic: Obtain and record consent to electronic records before signature

SAL-009.name: Census Data Minimum for Quoting
SAL-009.logic: Accept only fields needed to quote (age band or DOB, ZIP, wage, class code, coverage tier); no SSN or health detail before signature

SAL-010.name: Prospect Data Retention
SAL-010.logic: Delete or de-identify prospect personal data 24 months after last activity; keep decision records de-identified

SAL-011.name: Accessible Persona Experience
SAL-011.logic: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA; tested before each release

TEC-001.name: Multi-Tenant Data Isolation Model
TEC-001.logic: Enforce logical/physical isolation boundaries between client tenants at all data layers

TEC-005.name: Data Classification Rules (PII / PHI / Financial)
TEC-005.logic: Classify data element as PII, PHI, or financial and apply corresponding handling controls

TEC-006.name: State Data Privacy Statute Compliance (CCPA/CPRA and equivalents)
TEC-006.logic: Honor statutory consumer rights (access, deletion, opt-out) per applicable state privacy law

TEC-007.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Governance Baseline
TEC-007.logic: Grant access strictly per assigned role and attribute policy baseline

TEC-008.name: Immutable Audit Log Structure
TEC-008.logic: Write immutable, URI-traceable audit log entry for every governed transaction

TEC-010.name: Consent Tracking Module
TEC-010.logic: Record and enforce consent state for downstream data use

TEC-013.name: SSO/MFA Secure Endpoint Enforcement
TEC-013.logic: Require SSO with MFA before granting session access

TEC-016.name: Continuous SOC 1/SOC 2 Type II Attestation Cycle
TEC-016.logic: Maintain continuous evidence collection supporting rolling Type II attestation periods

TEC-017.name: Vulnerability & Penetration Testing Cadence
TEC-017.logic: Execute vulnerability scans and penetration tests; remediate findings per SLA

TEC-018.name: Periodic Access Review
TEC-018.logic: Review and recertify user access entitlements; revoke stale/excess access

TEC-019.name: Data Retention & Destruction Schedule
TEC-019.logic: Execute automated retention/destruction per schedule tied to data classification

TEC-021.name: Compiled Runtime Access Policy - HIPAA PHI Read Rule
TEC-021.logic: Default deny; allow only if user.role == BenefitsAdministrator AND user.tenant_id == resource.client_id AND session.mfa_authenticated == true

evals.question: Which HR, payroll, benefits and compliance tasks would the PEO take over, and which stay with us?
evals.expected: Task list with owner (PEO · client · shared) and source

evals.question: How do companies of our size and industry typically change cost and admin time after moving to a PEO?
evals.expected: Ranges with sample size and citation

evals.question: Under co-employment, who is the employer of record for payroll taxes, benefits and workers’ comp?
evals.expected: Per obligation: owner + rule citation

evals.question: What do we need to provide to get an indicative price?
evals.expected: Checklist of inputs and formats

evals.question: Are we eligible given our headcount, industry and states?
evals.expected: Yes/no per eligibility rule, with rule IDs

evals.question: Are any of our worksites, roles or employee classes excluded or restricted?
evals.expected: List of exclusions with rule and remedy

evals.question: Which of our states require PEO registration or licensing, and is the PEO licensed there?
evals.expected: Per-state table: requirement, licence status, as-of date

evals.question: What happens to our current benefit plans and broker relationship if we proceed?
evals.expected: Plain statement with conditions and dates

evals.question: What is our all-in cost today versus the PEO bundle, line by line (admin fee, workers’ comp, SUTA, benefits)?
evals.expected: Table of cost lines, current vs PEO, each cited

evals.question: How does cost change if we grow to 150 employees, and which thresholds do we cross?
evals.expected: Cost at each headcount + thresholds crossed (rule IDs)

evals.question: Which cost lines are estimates and which are binding, and what could change them before signing?
evals.expected: Per line: status, assumption, expiry date

evals.question: How does the PEO compare with the competitor offer we received?
evals.expected: Facts-only comparison with source links (EXT-004)

evals.question: For each of our states, which employer responsibilities does the PEO carry, which do we keep, and which are shared?
